title: Super Coalition Number in Graphs
summary: We introduce and investigate the structural properties of super coalition partitions in graphs, a novel direction that bridges cooperative resource deployment with rigid domination criteria. Based on the foundational concept of super domination, a super coalition partition is defined as a vertex set partitioning $Υ= \{A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_k\}$ such that no single class $A_i$ constitutes a valid super dominating set, yet every class can be paired with at least one distinct partner class $A_j$ to form a union $A_i \cup A_j$ that achieves full super domination over the graph.
